mapper.select:
select sale_id, sale_no, product_id, product_name, spec, category_id, qty, sale_price, amount, sale_time, status, create_by, create_time, remark from pms_sale
order by sale_id desc
select sale_id, sale_no, product_id, product_name, spec, category_id, qty, sale_price, amount, sale_time, status, create_by, create_time, remark from pms_sale where sale_id = #{saleId}
select max(sale_no) from pms_sale where sale_no like concat(#{prefix}, '%')
mapper.insert: insert into pms_sale (sale_no, product_id, product_name, spec, category_id, qty, sale_price, amount, sale_time, status, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{saleNo}, #{productId}, #{productName}, #{spec}, #{categoryId}, #{qty}, #{salePrice}, #{amount}, #{saleTime}, ifnull(#{status}, '0'), #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update pms_sale set status = #{status} where sale_id = #{saleId}
mapper.select: select ifnull(sum(amount),0) as turnover, ifnull(sum(qty),0) as qty, count(distinct product_id) as productCount from pms_sale

select
date_format(sale_time, '%Y-%u') date_format(sale_time, '%Y-%m') date_format(sale_time, '%Y') date_format(sale_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as label, ifnull(sum(amount),0) as value, ifnull(sum(qty),0) as qty from pms_sale
group by label order by label

select product_name as label, ifnull(sum(amount),0) as value, ifnull(sum(qty),0) as qty from pms_sale
group by product_id, product_name order by value desc limit 20
